thread:
Sophia L. (CSM): @here kicking off onboarding for Vervain Labs — want to lock owners, success criteria, and a lightweight 30/60/90 that we can share with the account. :wave:

Rahul P. (SE): I'll own the technical pairing sessions. Need to confirm data access and whether they'll use sandbox keys or bring test data.

Marta G. (AE): I'll sync on commercial milestones — their renewal check is 11 months out, so we should align an adoption milestone at 60 days to reduce renewal risk.

Eli T. (Onboarding): Proposed kickoff cadence: Week 0 onboarding call + weekly 45m enablement sprints for first 6 weeks. Draft 30/60/90:
- 30d: integration + smoke tests, first 2 use-cases live (basic routing)
- 60d: performance baseline, prompt library + cost optimizations
- 90d: scale plan, internal enablement + handoff to customer success ops

Sophia L. (CSM): Love it. Can each owner paste 2 acceptance criteria we can use for their milestone? I'll assemble into a one-pager for the customer.

Rahul P. (SE): Tech acceptance: 1) API calls <200ms p95 for baseline demo traffic, 2) KV cache working for session continuity, 3) sample dataset flows end-to-end with sanitized test data.

Marta G. (AE): Commercial acceptance: 1) Exec sponsor confirms value hypothesis, 2) Billing/Roles set up in our portal, 3) Renewal baseline logged in Salesforce with adoption owner.

Eli T. (Onboarding): Enablement acceptance: 1) 2 internal champions trained and can run a demo, 2) runbook created in Confluence, 3) first-week health check completed and OK.

Sophia L. (CSM): Risks flagged: customer wants HIPAA-ready logs by week 4 — that's medium risk if they need private deployment. Tagging infra/security later.

Rahul P. (SE): Noted. I'll circle with Eng-Security once we get their compliance ask. For now we'll request a redacted dataset and exception matrix.

Marta G. (AE): FYI commercial committed to a pilot PO by week 2. If that slips, renewal risk increases. I'll follow up with procurement contact.

Eli T. (Onboarding): Suggested meeting schedule (all invites will be calendared):
- Kickoff (30m): Mon 10am PT — draft agenda: goals, owners, timeline
- Tech pairing (60m): Wed 9am PT (weekly for 4 weeks)
- Enablement sprint (45m): Fri 11am PT (weekly for 6 weeks)
- 30/60/90 reviews: D30, D60, D90 (30m)

Sophia L. (CSM): ops-bot can you create the channel and a shared calendar event stub? I'll fill attendees.

ops-bot: Created channel #cs-vervain-onboard and calendar stub "Vervain Labs — Onboarding Kickoff" for Mon 10:00 PT (invite pending). :calendar:

Sophia L. (CSM): I'll drop the one-pager draft in the channel by EOD. Also we should have a short feedback capture form after each sprint — Eli, can you own the form?

Eli T. (Onboarding): Yep, will create a Google form and a Confluence page. I'll add three quick metrics: ease-of-use, latency satisfaction, and blockers.

Rahul P. (SE): Quick checklist for prep before kickoff:
```
- Sandbox keys requested
- Redacted sample data uploaded to S3
- Access to their network team for whitelisting
- List of example prompts/use-cases
```

Marta G. (AE): I'll put PO target date in the calendar and ask procurement for a narrow SLA list.

Sophia L. (CSM): Great. Next steps: owners confirm their acceptance criteria and any blockers by EOD tomorrow. I'll publish the one-pager and the Kickoff invite after that. :thumbsup:
